issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other (Solid Waste Fund column) 4,500.05
issues.issue: This is the Solid Waste Fund's only receipt line and is almost certainly refuse collection charges (Utility Charges). The printed label is 'Other' and no schedule confirms it, so other with a review note is defensible.

Exhibit A prints a 200.00 transfer (p1 line 20, p2 line 50), but the Schedule of Interfund Transfers on p3 is blank, even though its total should agree with those lines. This is a small internal inconsistency in the report and is not in report_discrepancies.
